item.title: Rain in the next week crucial for grain yield
item.description: After below-average rainfall in January and February across large parts of the summer grain-production region, widespread rain is now needed to achieve good grain harvests, according to a report by Grain SA.

item.title: FMD | Some milk and slaughter measures amended
item.description: The Department of Agriculture has amended some of the guidelines for the control of foot-and-mouth disease in an effort to ease restrictions on affected farmers.

item.title: Stud ram fetches R100 000 at 4 Africa Boerbok auction
item.description: A two-year-old Boerbok stud ram fetched the highest price of R100 000 at the 4 Africa breeders group’s summer auction, held at the Fire & Wine Centre in Pretoria on 7 February.

item.title: Have your say | Managing a crisis with ‘one eye closed’
item.description: Farmers do not need lectures about biosecurity. They need a system where telling the truth does not destroy their livelihoods, writes a farmer and agricultural development practitioner with experience across commercial and communal production systems.

item.title: FMD | 11 000 cattle vaccinated on the first day in KZN
item.description: A successful start to the foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination campaign in KwaZulu-Natal’s Ugu District has seen 11 000 cattle immunised on the opening day, with the programme now expanding to additional municipalities.

item.title: KZN implements total cattle movement ban as FMD vaccination kicks off
item.description: KwaZulu-Natal’s agricultural sector is facing its most challenging battle yet as MEC for Agriculture and Rural Development, Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, announced a comprehensive ban on all animal movements while launching an ambitious mass vaccination campaign to combat the severe foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak plaguing the province.

item.title: FMD | 1.5 million vaccine doses arriving from Türkiye this weekend
item.description: The first shipment of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine from Türkiye will arrive in South Africa this coming weekend.

item.title: Treasury unlocks R400 million to boost local FMD vaccine production
item.description: The Department of Agriculture will apply for funding via the Treasury’s Budget Facility for Infrastructure to expand and accelerate Onderstepoort Biological Products (OBP) production of its foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine, confirmed Dr Duncan Pieterse, director-general of finance.

item.title: Memorial speech for AFASA board member
item.description: Today I stand before you not only as a community member, not only as a farmer – but as a student. Because before Mr Mogajane was a leader in agriculture, before he was a pillar in the Africa Farmers Association of South Africa, he was a teacher. And I knew him first as Sir.
